pageChecks.title: MARTYR ASRAR AL-QABANDI  BILINGUAL SCHOOL – The school was established in 1997 by the grace and encouragement of Her Highness Sheikha Latifa Al-Fahad Al-Salem Al-Sabah (the head of the Kuwait Women’s Voluntary Society for Service and Community Development). Her Highness had a great concern to enrich the school with challenging and inspirational educational philosophy. The school was named by The Martyr Asrar Al Qabandi who was executed on 13/1/1991 during the Iraqi invasion in Kuwait and buried in Al-Reqa cemetery. She contacted the Kuwaiti political leadership outside Kuwait and followed their instructions. She took an honorable stand during the occupation days with the resistance groups. May God rest her soul in peace.
